build_oauth_authorization_redirect: build an OAuth authorization redirect that forwards to upstream provider with PKCE support
exchange_oauth_token: exchange an OAuth authorization code for an access token with PKCE and refresh token support
register_oauth_client: register an OAuth client with an upstream provider and return client credentials
build_oauth_discovery_response: build an OAuth protected resource or authorization server discovery response for MCP clients
encode_oauth_state: encode OAuth state with base URL and PKCE parameters for secure session handling
